description.value:
Features

Mastery (Push)

If you hit a creature with this weapon, you can push the creature up to 10 feet straight away from you.

Artillery Shells

Bonus Action.

The weapon holds up to 4 shells. You can use a Bonus Action to quickly reload all expended shells.

Shelling Strike

The gunlance isn't meant for long-range sniping; it's for point-blank destruction. When you hit a creature with a melee attack using this weapon, you can expend 1 shell to trigger an explosion inside their guard. The target takes an extra [[/r 1d6]] Thunder damage.

Guard Reload

Reaction.

When a creature misses you with a melee attack while you are wielding the shield, you can use your Reaction to brace yourself and instantly reload up to 2 expended shells.
